Beginning of Wave 13 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Keep an eye out!|Beginning of Wave 10 ([[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hidden''' is an [[Enemies|enemy]] that cannot be attacked by towers without hidden detection that appears in [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]], [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]], [[Molten Mode|Molten]], Basic Arena [[PVP]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes, and the [[Tutorial]]. It serves to introduce the need for hidden detection, and can be a nuisance without it. It is slightly faster than the [[Normal]] and [[Abnormal]]. The [[Grave Digger]] had a chance to spawn the '''Hidden''' with its ''Triumphing Sheol'' ability in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. The '''Hidden''' was also formerly spawned by the [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]] before its replacement. The [[Tombstone]] could also spawn the '''Hidden''' before its removal. The [[Mystery]] can summon the '''Hidden''' upon death. It also appeared as parts of the [[SFOTH Event]], [[Metaverse Champions Event]] and [[The Classic Event]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Hidden''' is a humanoid with a dark grey translucent body with a slime-like texture. It is faceless, wears a black blindfold and emits black smoke from its body. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Hidden''' had a dark grey translucent body, as well as a dark grey blindfold. It was faceless and emitted grey particles. }} |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the legacy '''Hidden''' has a translucent grey body. It has a black cobblestone torso and legs and wears a black headband on its head. It has a glowing white scar on its face, which has two leaks on the right side of its face. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The current [[Enemies Beta]] version of the '''Hidden''' has a dark grey translucent body, as well as a dark grey blindfold. It is faceless and emits grey particles. |Version 3 |The third version of the legacy '''Hidden''' is similar to the current version, except it has a sad face. |Version 2 |The second version of the legacy '''Hidden''' had a light grey skin color, as well as a navy granite torso and dark navy granite legs. It wore a black headband and had a drooling zombie face. |Version 1 |The first version of the legacy '''Hidden''' was a white translucent ghost with its torso and legs being slightly less translucent and grey in color. It had a drooling zombie face. }} }} ==Strategy== *Most early game towers tend to gain hidden detection on one of its upgrades; these towers are sufficient to deal with early '''Hiddens'''. Such towers include the [[Soldier]], [[Sniper]], [[Shotgunner]], [[Militant]], [[Assassin]], and [[Golden Scout]]. **As '''Hiddens''' spawn in hordes, the [[Golden Pyromancer]] is particularly useful, being able to damage multiple enemies at once and having hidden detection by default. The regular [[Pyromancer]] also gains hidden detection at Level 2 and is a less effective, but still strong tower against '''Hiddens'''. **If you can use the [[Farm]] well, the [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] are feasible choices, though they are not necessary and are fairly expensive, especially in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. *For splash damage towers that cannot target '''Hiddens''', such as the [[Mortar]] and [[Demoman]], if a '''Hidden''' is caught up in an explosion, they will be dealt splash damage. **This means that another detectable enemy must be near the '''Hidden''' for a splash damage tower to hit it. **While the [[Rocketeer]] has hidden detection, it should not be used early on due to its high upgrade and placement costs. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous
